name: Text as a whole
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council amending Regulations (EU) 2015/1017, (EU) 2021/523, (EU) 2021/695 and (EU) 2021/1153 as regards increasing the efficiency of the EU guarantee under Regulation (EU) 2021/523 and simplifying reporting requirements
part_text:
The European Parliament wants to change the InvestEU programme, which uses EU budget guarantees to help private and public lenders finance projects. The changes would increase the EU guarantee by EUR 4.5 billion, allow unused money from older EU loan schemes to be combined with InvestEU, and let Member States contribute through a new financial instrument. Reporting rules would be simplified, especially for small operations, and the definition of small and medium-sized enterprises would be made easier to apply.

- The EU guarantee grows by EUR 4.5 billion, with about EUR 70 billion more investment expected to be mobilised.
- Small businesses face lighter reporting and simpler rules to prove their size.
- Parliament adopted its position; talks with Member States on the final text come next.
